sloka: तस्य तल्लोकपालस्य वरुणस्य सुभाषितम् ।उर्वशी परमप्रीता श्रुत्वा वाक्यमुवाच ह ।। ७.५६.१९ ॥
transliteration: tasya tallokapālasya varuṇasya subhāṣitam ।urvaśī paramaprītā śrutvā vākyamuvāca ha ।। 7.56.19 ॥

translations.english: Having heard those well-spoken words of Varuna, the protector of the world, Urvashi was extremely pleased and spoke.
translations.hindi: इसीसे में उसे अयोध्या में ले आया था । किन्तु अब यह सहापवाद्‌ सुझको बड़ा सता रहा हे
